case.story: My husband left me and I want a divorce and maintenance for my child. What are my rights?

red_flags.message: Family matters (divorce, custody, maintenance, inheritance) are not covered here.

questions: What is your husband's current income or employment status?
Do you have a marriage certificate or any proof of marriage?
Do you have your child's birth certificate or any documents proving parentage?
llm.summary: The user seeks a divorce and maintenance for her child after her husband left. She wants to know her legal rights regarding separation and child support.

result.markdown:
### You should talk to a real lawyer
- Family matters (divorce, custody, maintenance, inheritance) are not covered here.
Free legal aid: call the NALSA helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority. Women and children are eligible whatever they earn; others qualify under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, for example by income. [LA-NALSA]

**Sources (checked 2026-11-21):**
- [LA-NALSA] https://nalsa.gov.in/legal-services/ · https://nalsa.gov.in/services/legal-aid/eligibility?locale=ma
